info.title: CF Meet messaging private Communications integration
info.description: Private backend interfaces for Sections 4–7 and the Sections 9–23 owner interfaces. Never routed by public ingress or advertised by public Swagger. The owner retains canonical data. Scope, permissions and identities come from signed service authentication; request bodies cannot impersonate principals.

post.summary: Read the delegated user's current access to one conversation
post.description: Read the delegated user's current access to one conversation. A non-member and an unknown conversation are the same member:false answer; a message before the member's history window, of another kind or unknown is NOT_FOUND. Private signed service traffic only; the delegated tenant, application and environment must match the verified Platform Access authority. Permission messaging-communications.read is granted only by the receiving service trust policy. Replayed JWT hops are refused by the Hub; events and commands additionally deduplicate their durable identities. Failures never grant communications. Sections 9–23 owner interface: the signed delegated context must carry the governed personal scope (any other scope is 404) and principalId must equal its NATIVE_CF_USER initiating principal (otherwise 403).

post.summary: List attachment metadata visible to the delegated member
post.description: List attachment metadata visible to the delegated member. Only attachments of ACTIVE application messages inside the member's history window, after afterSequence and not hidden for the member, newest first. PRIVATE_E2EE attachments are always ENCRYPTED and are never decrypted, inspected or scanned. A non-member is 404. Private signed service traffic only; the delegated tenant, application and environment must match the verified Platform Access authority. Permission messaging-communications.read is granted only by the receiving service trust policy. Replayed JWT hops are refused by the Hub; events and commands additionally deduplicate their durable identities. Failures never grant communications. cfServiceAuth.name: X-CF-Service-Authorization
cfServiceAuth.description: Bearer EdDSA service JWT from cf-service-auth; audience, runtime, request IDs, scope, expiration and receiver-granted permission are verified.

data.description: Metadata-only domain event, never message content, credentials, invitation tokens or media.

memberPrincipalIds.description: ACTIVE members, sorted ascending, at most 256.

ConversationAccess.description: member:false carries nothing else; member:true carries every property except message, which is present only when messageId was requested.

afterSequence.description: Excludes attachments whose message sequence is <= afterSequence.

DevicePushRequest.description: registration is required for REGISTER and refused for REMOVE.

handle.description: Opaque push handle; passed to the canonical registration, never returned or logged.

PushRegistration.description: Exactly the customer push-registration request body.

pushServices.description: Whether this deployment holds delivery credentials for each push service.

environmentQuotaBytes.description: The environment storage budget shared by every user; null when unlimited.
